lead: A small publishing house in Sweden, made by people who love a good question.
intro: Telning Publishing House makes wordless picture books for children aged 0 to 7. Each story is coloured by the child, who then chooses how it ends. Behind the books is a small team of cognitive and behavioural scientists in Uppsala, Sweden.

team.line: Telning books are created by our team of cognitive and behavioural scientists.
team.text: We are a small team in Sweden. We read the research, write the story scripts, test the books with families, and answer every story card ourselves.

made.h2: How is a Telning book made?

steps.t: We start from what studies say about shared reading, wordless books and talking about feelings.
One line per picture: what we see, what the character feels, what changes. Then the fork with two endings.
Our illustrator draws every page by hand. No AI pictures inside a Telning book.
Real children, real crayons. We change what confuses, and we keep what starts a talk.
One picture per sheet, printed on one side, so markers do not come through.

items.t: We say what a book is, not what it will do. No big claims, no numbers from studies on a cover.
Every picture inside a Telning book is drawn by a person. No AI pictures inside.
A story card needs a first name, an age and a drawing. Never a photo of a child. We delete what we do not need.
We write only when a book is out. No tracking, no cookies on this site.

name.t1: "Telning" is Swedish for a young shoot, a sapling. In older Swedish it also means a child.
name.t2: Telning Publishing House is made in Sweden.

contact.text: Questions, ideas, a story to tell us? Write to us. We read every email.
